description: This file defines command-line test commands for the Mattermost server, including web client tests and server setup for testing, utilizing Cobra CLI framework and external packages for server control and testing execution.

methods.name: webClientTestsCmdF
methods.description: Handles execution of web client tests, initializes server, translations, and API, then runs tests.

methods.name: serverForWebClientTestsCmdF
methods.description: Sets up server for web client testing, handles signals for termination.

methods.name: setupClientTests
methods.description: Configures client test environment by enabling/disabling server features.

methods.name: executeTestCommand
methods.description: Executes a command, streams output, and handles errors.

methods.name: runWebClientTests
methods.description: Runs npm tests in the web app directory.
